value.rationale: Cherry count is a standard measurable shape descriptor for random phylogenies, and root split is a natural conditioning variable. Exact characterization of which root balances minimize/maximize its conditional fluctuation across all sample sizes, with the sharp finite threshold 15 and persistent 1/32 advantage, addresses a motivated model-comparison uncertainty; this is more than unmotivated arithmetic on a marginal table.
